steps.name: Open builder
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Edit Itinerary** / **Build Itinerary** to open the builder if needed.

steps.name: Finish with date only
steps.do: On **Set Visit Date**, pick a date and click **Finish** without adding animals, attractions, talks, encounters, or transport.
steps.expect: Itinerary saves with that visit date and no selected items.

steps.name: Clear itinerary
steps.expect: **Clear Itinerary?** confirmation appears with the remove-all message.
